The net ATP from substrate-level phosphorylation is 2 from glucose and 3 from glycogen, so the answer is A. Glucose spends one ATP at hexokinase and one at phosphofructokinase, then both routes form four ATP at phosphoglycerate kinase and pyruvate kinase; glycogen skips hexokinase and spends only the phosphofructokinase ATP, leaving a net of three.

CONFIDENCE: 96
